下界合金外骨骼 ![Exoskeleton Back](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/231362f137dbe6f572ada6dbdaccdc76ae81f76b.png) ![Exoskeleton Front](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/024502b070f44d16f195d9c94e687c45dfeef775.png)
下界合金噴氣背包 ![Jetpack Back](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90261abbb323e0cc8835f088960c56f8bddbbbd4.png) ![Jetpack Front](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/11233b577c4b6631a7fc51f4d3c71bbf1fa6d606.png)
合成配方 ![Exoskeleton Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d32b31956de0795b20f929e48beee42c8a4ad81a.png) ![Jetpack Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9f12d6467a4c39802743b9b15eae2592f0914ca.png) ![Nether Engine Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3724c191fab9d8e20ef1756bf370345bba104525.png) ![Flywheel Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/313a6f7dace304098177c1290764aee541c0767e.png)
此模組為 FurtiTwo 開發的 [Create Stuff & Additions](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-stuff-additions) 中的噴氣背包與外骨骼加入了終局變體。 下界合金版本的屬性與普通下界合金胸甲相同。 ***運作此模組需安裝 [CreateSA](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-stuff-additions) 與 [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)**。
本模組可自由用於任何整合包中。 請於 [CURSEFORGE-COMMENTS](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create-netherite-additions/comments) 或我的 [DISCORD SERVER](https://discord.gg/aYycXd9XeJ) 回報問題。 本模組亦提供於 [Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create-netherite-additions)
